runs: Two complete calibration executions (three formats each) and one complete heldout execution. No failed or discarded scored execution; all competence-gate failures retained.
repairs_before_scoring: Calibration execution corrected from single prefill to the frozen parent/update/query boundaries before any model inference.
Exact model revisions and verified asset loading enforced before scoring.
pre_inference_checks: Token boundaries and twin positions validated for all cases without loading weights.
Strict parser rejects prose, periods, duplicate JSON keys, numeric JSON values and non-ASCII digit values.
Synthetic checks verify comparisons stop after the first divergent generated-token decision, signed-zero hashes differ, and plain runtime metadata safely roundtrips with weights_only=True.
scope: 24 cases in 12 twin pairs; eight calibration cases, 16 heldout cases. 192 calibration generations, 64 uninterrupted heldout references and 384 heldout arm observations. Same-model synthetic KV restoration; no whole-agent, cross-model or subjective-continuity claim.
verification: Independent review confirmed raw arithmetic and scientific report. In-memory corruptions of gold, correctness, parsing, aggregates, selection policy, logit hashes and parent-receipt bindings were rejected. Consistent simulated restoration drift and a swapped-history fidelity mismatch remained valid negative evidence. No neural inference rerun during review.
external_binary_scope: Checkpoint and full-logit files remain outside Git. Their serialized and raw tensor hashes were verified in the actual run; default CI validates receipt consistency and arithmetic, not external binary contents.
